macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Hot U.S. inflation sends stocks lower and revives Fed hike concerns
items.summary: September U.S. CPI rose 3.7% year over year, above the 3.6% forecast, while core inflation reached 2.6%. The S&P 500 fell 1.11%, the Nasdaq 100 dropped 2.02%, and the Dow slipped 0.09% as investors reassessed the outlook for Federal Reserve policy.

items.title: AI stocks lead market selloff after inflation report
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite fell about 1.9% in its worst session since July, while Nvidia, Broadcom, and AMD dropped 3.2%, 3.1%, and 5.7%, respectively. Traders increased the implied probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the next meeting, although expectations moderated later.

items.title: TSMC reports record profit on strong AI-chip demand
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor reported third-quarter net profit of T$763.1 billion, up 69% from a year earlier and above expectations, as demand for artificial-intelligence processors remained strong.

items.title: U.S. bank earnings deliver mixed results
items.summary: Morgan Stanley and BlackRock exceeded quarterly profit and revenue expectations, but their share-price reactions diverged. Bank of America missed revenue and earnings forecasts, sending its shares down 4.76%.

items.title: China trade data beats expectations
items.summary: China’s September trade surplus expanded to $133.53 billion from $119.09 billion in August. Exports rose 36.3% year over year, substantially exceeding forecasts and providing support for global-growth expectations.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ether fall as hotter U.S. inflation raises rate concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin fell about 4% over 24 hours and Ether about 6.5% after U.S. inflation exceeded expectations, pressuring risk assets and briefly lifting expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike. The broader crypto market also saw heavy liquidations.[2][6]

items.title: USDC designated the EU’s first significant e-money token under MiCA
items.summary: European regulators classified Circle’s USDC as the first significant e-money token under the Markets in Crypto-Assets framework. Supervision of its reserves and cross-border activities will involve the European Banking Authority and French regulators.[1][7]

items.title: White House crypto adviser Patrick Witt leaves amid stalled CLARITY Act
items.summary: Patrick Witt has reportedly departed as the White House’s top crypto adviser, with no successor named. The U.S. CLARITY Act remains short of the votes needed for Senate passage.[1]

items.title: Standard Chartered receives UAE approval for direct Bitcoin and Ether trading
items.summary: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ether trading for affluent clients in the United Arab Emirates after authorization from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority.[5][6]

items.title: Sui and DATA Foundation partnership sends WAL sharply higher
items.summary: WAL rose roughly 47% after the Sui Foundation and DATA Foundation announced that DATA’s AI-training-data registry, with more than 250 million verifiable receipts, would join the Sui ecosystem and use Walrus for default storage.[5]

items.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow mainnet deployment
items.summary: Solana is preparing to activate its Alpenglow upgrade around October 21, targeting transaction confirmation times of about 150 milliseconds.[10]

items.title: UN­CX vesting-contract vulnerability causes $86,000 loss
items.summary: Blockaid identified a vulnerability in an UNCX Network vesting smart contract that resulted in approximately $86,000 in losses across five ERC-20 tokens.[8]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Microsoft launches Xbox Labs
items.summary: Microsoft introduced Xbox Labs, a team focused on adapting games for web browsers and devices beyond their original platforms. The company has not yet announced specific games, release dates, or pricing.[2]

items.title: Valor Mortis releases on PC and current-generation consoles
items.summary: One More Level, the studio behind Ghostrunner, released the first-person action game Valor Mortis for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The game also joined Game Pass.[4]

items.title: Brazil expands public support for game development
items.summary: Brazil’s government signed regulations recognizing video games as audiovisual and cultural products, allowing developers to seek cultural funding. The initiative also includes a public platform for Brazilian games, startup support, and expanded university education.[3]

items.title: Sony announces Midnight Black PlayStation 5 Digital Edition
items.summary: Sony announced a Midnight Black PlayStation 5 Digital Edition for Japan, with sales scheduled to begin November 19, 2026, and preorders opening October 20.[4]

items.title: Epic Games faces criticism over AI-first strategy
items.summary: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney said the Fortnite maker is moving toward AI-first production, prompting criticism over generative AI’s role in development. The strategy could also lead to broader AI development tools in future Unreal Engine releases.[10]

items.title: NVIDIA reportedly halts GeForce RTX 5090 production
items.summary: Industry insiders reportedly claim NVIDIA has stopped producing the GeForce RTX 5090 and is reallocating GB202 chips toward higher-margin professional AI products. The report has not been confirmed by NVIDIA.[4]

items.title: 007 First Light dated for Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: IO Interactive announced that 007 First Light will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on March 18, 2027, alongside a trailer showing the game running on the console.[4]
